caption: The drawing depicts a wooden window set into a light beige or off-white wall, with three blue-colored shutters or panels. The shutter on the left side is open outward, and it is solid blue with visible wood grain texture and shading variations. Behind the open shutter, there is a window section divided into four rectangular glass panes separated by blue muntins. The center and right shutters of the window are closed, with the center panel slightly narrower and featuring a vertical bolt latch at the bottom and two angled handles. The rightmost shutter is plain blue wood with rectangular framing and is secured by three rusty brown metal hinges. There is a small, subtle shadow to the left of the open shutter and beneath the window ledge, and the edges of the wall around the window opening show faint shading and pencil lines. The artist’s signature, "Geoffrey Holt," appears in black ink in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Grille and Mission-House Window (Interior)
